Name: Fluffy Hair Emily
Author: crispykalechipss
Description:
This mod is compatible with version 1.6 (use previous version if you are still playing on 1.5)

--Please make sure you are running the game with SMAPI and Content Patcher--

This mod gives Emily fluffy hair with bangs, and a dress that matches her sprite better. I included the beach and winter portraits and sprites as well. The hairstyle is somewhat inspired by the character Ramona Flowers!


This mod is compatible with my other portrait and sprite mods. It is also compatible with other content patcher portrait mods (I tested It specifically with Leyalluna's Portrait mod and it worked perfectly).
I also tested it with the Portraiture mod, and I was able to switch between the large and small portrait.
This mod has not been tested with the seasonal portraits mod, and may not work correctly with it.


If you would like to disable the mod, simply remove it from your mods folder until you would like to use it again.

If you find any bugs, or have any suggestions, feel free make a post on the mod page and let me know, and I will respond if I can!

If you would like to make any edits to the mod, please ask me first before redistributing.
